Most Data Engineer interviews are no longer focused only on SQL or PySpark syntax.
Here are some important interview scenarios asked in Birlasoft 👇
✅ One source arrives late in a multi-source pipeline
✅ PySpark job failing due to data skew
✅ ADF pipeline failed in the last step
✅ SQL query running for 20 minutes
✅ Designing CDC pipeline for 10M+ daily records
✅ Data quality issues in incoming files
✅ Migrating on-prem database to Azure Synapse
The interesting part?
These questions test:
• Problem-solving
• Production debugging
• Optimization thinking
• Scalable architecture design
• Recovery strategies
Not just tool knowledge.
If you are preparing for Data Engineering interviews in 2026, focus more on:
• Scenario-based questions
• Failure handling
• Pipeline optimization
• Metadata-driven architecture
• Real-time debugging approaches
That’s what companies expect from experienced candidates now.

ai_analysis.summary: This 2026-focused post argues that data engineering interviews emphasize real-world scenarios and problem-solving rather than only SQL or PySpark syntax. It lists scenarios involving late-arriving pipeline sources, PySpark data skew, an ADF failure, a slow SQL query, high-volume CDC, incoming-file data quality, and migration from an on-premises database to Azure Synapse. It also identifies production debugging, optimization, scalable architecture, recovery strategies, metadata-driven architecture, and real-time debugging as important preparation areas, but it does not provide detailed solutions or implementation techniques.
subtopics: Data quality issues in incoming files
On-premises database migration to Azure Synapse

interview_questions.question: What capabilities does the post say its listed data engineering interview scenarios test?
interview_questions.answer:
The scenarios test problem-solving and production debugging.
They also test optimization thinking, scalable architecture design, and recovery strategies.
Syntax-only knowledge is presented as insufficient for the listed scenarios.

interview_questions.question: Which areas of preparation does the post recommend for experienced data engineering interviews in 2026?
interview_questions.answer:
Preparation should include scenario-based questions and failure handling.
Candidates should focus on pipeline optimization and metadata-driven architecture.
Real-time debugging approaches are also identified as an important focus.

interview_questions.question: A PySpark job fails because of data skew. What does this example indicate interviewers want beyond PySpark syntax?
interview_questions.answer:
The example requires recognizing a PySpark failure associated with data skew.
It calls for production debugging, optimization thinking, and problem-solving rather than syntax knowledge alone.

interview_questions.question: An SQL query has been running for 20 minutes. Why does the post treat this as an optimization-related interview scenario?
interview_questions.answer:
The query duration makes it a long-running SQL performance scenario.
The post associates this kind of problem with optimization thinking and practical problem-solving.
